description: Every token a wallet holds, with USD values, across Robinhood Chain, HyperEVM, Base, Arbitrum and Ethereum for a 0x address (or one chain with chain), or on Solana for a Solana address. Includes ETH, HYPE or SOL, stablecoins, Robinhood stock tokens and memecoins. Values: $1 for stablecoins, the ETH or HYPE price for the native token and its wrapped form, Chainlink for stock tokens, Uniswap pools on Robinhood Chain (a router buy when the pool is thin), a small buy routed by 0x elsewhere. The biggest positions carry a quick risk verdict (run token_risk for the full check). Tokens that look like airdropped spam are hidden and counted; tokens with no route to sell are listed apart. If the router is busy, a holding is valued from its last good quote (at most 15 minutes old) and marked priceAsOf.
